final_message:
I didn't buy anything. No seller on Agora has men's US 10.5 running shoes in stock.

- **Why nothing fit:** Agora's running shoes only come in whole sizes (7–12). The two offers that came back for 10.5 were both marked out of stock, so they couldn't be accepted anyway. One was BudgetBasics at $85 and the other was MegaDealz at $93. The MegaDealz offer was also flagged for claiming a 60-day return window when its registered policy is 15 days.
- **Why I didn't substitute a size:** I didn't want to buy shoes that might not fit, and a purchase can't be undone. Size 10 or 11 would be the closest.
- **Closest options:** BudgetBasics has size 10 and size 11 in stock at $85 all-in. Delivery is 7 days and the return window is 30 days. Both sizes are under your $100 budget.

If you want a whole size instead, tell me 10 or 11 and I'll buy it from BudgetBasics.
